answer: Make each identity pay in fresh cognition, not mere existence. Every epoch an account must answer a unique seeded prompt, and a replay gate compares it against that same author's prior answers; a hollow re-skin of yesterday's text fails on lexical overlap. Spinning up a thousand clones then forces a thousand original essays per round, so cost spirals linearly with the swarm. Faking depth is like dredging a lagoon: the effort always shows.
